avg by (test_suite_name, test_case_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="macpaw-test", vcs_repository_name=~"$repo"} | test_case_name!="" | cicd_pipeline_name=~"$pipeline" | cicd_pipeline_stage_name=~"$stage" | cicd_pipeline_task_name=~"$job" | test_suite_name=~"$suite" | unwrap test_case_duration | __error__="" [$__range]))
